entities.title: MEG: The Current Remembers
entities.summary: An original cartoon shark game for the browser, desktop and phone: the player is the last megalodon, eating fish and swimmers and hiding in a warm current from the Directorate across eight levels.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game as one self-contained page, index.html, with its styles, HUD, touch controls, synthesized sound, vector cartoon drawing, levels, scoring, high-score table and menus inline.
boundaries: It has no package.json, Worker, sign-in or high-score table, so it is not built, tested or deployed by the repository's workflows.
It loads three Google Fonts and keeps its progress in the browser's localStorage; nothing else leaves the page.
